en:
I'm done waiting around for my white knight. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Time to get moving again! Although, maybe
I'll just go handle things myself at home.
This is your last chance, so try and find
me at my new spot! I'll be waiting... <symbol=note_with_outline>

My friend just told me that the sick person
was saved by some good Samaritan who
gave them some medicine. There's hope
for you yet, Onomichi!

A friend of mine said someone saved that
sick person. Was it the guy who replied?
Well, they're apparently recovering fine,
thanks to you. Kamurocho is in good hands!

The patron saint of public restrooms himself
was able to spare me a square! Thank you,
oh benevolent lord of the lavatory!

That person really was an arsonist. Too
bad they got away. Did the guy who
replied chase them away? If so, great work!

So it WAS shady! And you stopped a purse-
snatcher! You've done the world a favor!

Apparently that little boy was just really
hungry. He said a nice tourist gave him
some food. I'm glad he wasn't ill, though!

Not how I would have solved the problem,
but I guess giving a drunk more alcohol
works, as long as it makes him stop
bothering people!

Thank goodness, the child was found.
Considering how dangerous it's been
getting these days, I'm glad this all
worked out okay.

I heard the person was safely rescued.
They were pretty high up, so if they fell,
it probably would've been bad. I'm
relieved, so relieved.

I heard some buff guy pulled the person up
to safety. The world still has some good in it
after all!

Apparently someone gave those
shakedown guys a proper beat down.
Was it the guy who replied to my post?
If so, thanks, man. I'm glad Kamurocho
still has people like you around.

Man, whoever you are, you're stronger
than anyone I know! That should teach
those punks a lesson. I just hope they
know better than to come back...

You're so amazing. I think it finally got
through to those guys. I heard from a friend
that they don't think it's worth the pain
anymore. I bet that's the end of that
shakedown problem for our city.

I saw this dude in a gray suit beating the
living shit out of those thugs. Was it the guy
who replied? If so, thanks. It was great
seeing those guys get taken down a peg!

The Champion of Justice LIVES!
Those guys were beaten to bloody pulps!
Serves 'em right, too! LMAO!

I knew we could depend on you. They
must've learned their lesson by now. No
one's going to bother middle-aged men in
this city again after what happened to those
guys.

Those perverts got the beat down they
deserved. I'd say it was divine punishment
that the guy who wrecked them was built
like a bulldozer.

ROFLMAO! I saw those guys getting the
beating of their lives. They were really
aggressive to all those girls, and that
reflects poorly on EVERYONE. So, I'm
really thankful to whoever beat them up!
That'll do, pig!

Those guys just got REKT, LOL. Serves 'em
right, if you ask me! I think they're done
messing with girls in Kamurocho. Hopefully
that makes this city at least a little safer for
women to walk around in...

I'm sure you just saved a life, buddy. Not
all heroes wear capes, apparently. Some
wear really outdated suits.

Someone swooped in to save the victim
from that mob. I sure am glad there are
good people on this network and in the
world.

I saw that the victim made it out unscathed.
They told a reporter that a random stranger
risked his life in an all-out street fight to put
that mob down. Just goes to show, there are
still some good people in Kamurocho.
Hopefully this means the mobs will die
down now. And if not... I bet this guy will
show up to save the day again! Heh.

I watched you fight those guys. You beat
them to a bloody pulp without breaking
a sweat! That was awesome!

HAHAHA! Those guys got absolutely LIT UP.
That'll teach 'em! Hahaha, I'm dying here!
LOLOL

Those guys got so busted up, they could
barely stumble out of the building. I bet
those punks couldn't harass another couple
if they tried! Whoever did all this... Love
has won, thanks to you!

Looks like the pickpocket got his hand in
the wrong pocket. I heard he got the
crap kicked out of him.

I guess some dude rolled up into the
cemetery and took out the whole gang of
grave robbers. You, sir, have bigger balls
than I do.

This scary but also kind of sweet guy
made my delivery for me! My back was
hurting soba'd...

Looks like someone extinguished that fire.
I'm glad we didn't have to go through
another big fire in the city! Thanks to the
one who made it over there in time!

I heard you went in with a fire extinguisher
and put out that fire single-handedly!
You're incredible!

The smoke stopped. Did the guy who
said he'd put it out really get to it in time?
If so, you're the man, anon!

Thank goodness someone had a fire
extinguisher! I'm sure that car's owner
really appreciates you, buddy. And so do
we!

You did it, Kiryu-san. I knew you could.
That guy was pretty terrible, huh?

Not bad. You deserve some credit, I
suppose... But this isn't over by a long shot.

I hear the fire got put out and they
even caught they guy who did it!
Troublr is going nuts saying the guy
who posted solved everything!
Way to go!

Sounds like we really are dealing with an
arsonist. But I guess the guy who responded
must have put out the fire. I'm glad you
stopped it before it did any real damage.

Looks like it was another arson attempt, but
someone got to it with a fire extinguisher
before it got out of hand. Was it the guy
who replied?

It really WAS arson. This is becoming a real
problem. Thank you, whoever put it out!

I really DID see an arsonist. Someone said
he got away, but maybe it was because the
guy who replied chased him off? Good job!

Kiryu-san! I got some information from
a friend! Red, cut the red!

With people taking swings at you left and right, you need to know how
to defend yourself. Hold <Sign:6,Combat> to put your guard up and block incoming attacks.

Watch for openings in an enemy's attacks and strike!

Sometimes dodging can be an easier option than guarding.
Press <Sign:3,Combat> to evade in the direction you're moving in.

Dodging is more difficult than guarding, but it makes it easier
to find openings in the enemy's attacks.

If you want to keep your eyes on your opponent, hold <Sign:4,Combat> to lock on to them.

Kiryu will always face the enemy regardless of how you move around.
Staying focused on the fight is important on both offense and defense.

Press <Sign:2,Combat> to perform a quick attack. If you want to keep up the pressure,
chain quick attacks together into a Rush Combo by pressing <Sign:2,Combat> up to four times.
Getting in some swift jabs can open up your opponent to other attacks.

<Sign:2,Combat>/<Sign:2,Combat><Sign:2,Combat>/<Sign:2,Combat><Sign:2,Combat><Sign:2,Combat>/<Sign:2,Combat><Sign:2,Combat><Sign:2,Combat><Sign:2,Combat>

During a Rush Combo, pressing <Sign:1,Combat> will unleash a powerful attack called a
Finishing Blow. Not only does a Finishing Blow cause some serious damage, but
it can also stun whoever winds up on the receiving end.

<Sign:2,Combat><Sign:1,Combat>/<Sign:2,Combat><Sign:2,Combat><Sign:1,Combat>/<Sign:2,Combat><Sign:2,Combat><Sign:2,Combat><Sign:1,Combat>/<Sign:2,Combat><Sign:2,Combat><Sign:2,Combat><Sign:2,Combat><Sign:1,Combat>

You can follow up a Finishing Blow by pressing <Sign:1,Combat> again to unleash a
Double Finisher. While it leaves you wide open, landing a Double Finisher
causes massive damage and blows your enemies away.

<Sign:2,Combat><Sign:1,Combat><Sign:1,Combat>/<Sign:2,Combat><Sign:2,Combat><Sign:1,Combat><Sign:1,Combat>/<Sign:2,Combat><Sign:2,Combat><Sign:2,Combat><Sign:1,Combat><Sign:1,Combat>/<Sign:2,Combat><Sign:2,Combat><Sign:2,Combat><Sign:2,Combat><Sign:1,Combat><Sign:1,Combat>

Successful attacks and blocks will fire up Kiryu and fill your Heat Orbs.
Press <Sign:1,Combat> when the Heat Icon appears to expend a Heat Orb and
activate a Heat Action. Heat Actions are incredibly powerful special
attacks that will wreak havoc on your unfortunate foes.
Heat Actions you can execute change based on the current conditions of the
fight, so be ready to press <Sign:1,Combat> as soon as you see the Heat Icon!

Heat Orbs can also be used to enter a special mode called Extreme Heat Mode.
Press <Sign:5,Combat> to burst into flames and awaken the Dragon of Dojima. 

In this form, your Heat will drain quickly and attacks cost Heat. However,
there are weapons and special attacks that can only be used in this mode.
Pain won't even faze you, so it's perfect for one-on-one fights.

Some nasty thugs just wander around town looking for fights for the hell of it.
You can ignore them, but you can earn rewards by teaching them a lesson.

When an enemy is guarding, you can grab them out of it with <Sign:0,Combat> and
follow up with an attack, or press <Sign:0,Combat> again to throw them.

Throwing enemies is a great tactic for when you're surrounded.

<Sign:0,Combat><Sign:2,Combat>/<Sign:0,Combat><Sign:1,Combat>/<Sign:0,Combat><Sign:0,Combat>

Objects with <symbol=black_down_triangle> displayed above them can be picked up with <Sign:0,Combat> to use as a weapon.
The more painful something looks, the more damage it will probably do. 

When you're in a pinch, checking your surroundings for a weapon can turn
the tables on your enemies!

Dangerous weapons, like knives or guns, can't be blocked by guarding.
Your only options are dodging with <Sign:3,Combat> or picking up a large object
to defend yourself.

You'll have to be careful, as some attacks can't be guarded by small weapons.

Enemies wielding weapons can be disarmed by knocking them down or grabbing 
them. Dropped weapons can be picked up, so you should always focus on 
enemies with weapons first. Fair is fair when they bring a knife to a fistfight.

Some enemies are too strong to be disarmed, so you'll have to be cautious.

You can use EXP to strengthen Kiryu's abilities. 
You can choose between various ability tabs with <Sign:6,UI>/<Sign:4,UI>,
but it's recommended to strengthen Kiryu's basic stats first.
You know what to do. Time to beat down your foes however you see fit.
